summary: Nexa Resources S.A. (NYSE: NEXA), a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder meeting results. The annual general meeting approved a share premium reimbursement of approximately US$0.132136 per common share, totaling US$17.5 million, payable on August 11, 2026, to shareholders of record as of July 28, 2026. The extraordinary meeting also approved an increase in authorized share capital and related articles. This is a capital return event with a special dividend-like distribution. The board recommended all resolutions. The filing is equivalent to a U.S. proxy result filing. Watch for actual payment date and any future capital allocation changes.
